gre_subject.value: No GRE Subject Test exists for this field: ETS discontinued the GRE Biology Test in May 2021.
gre_subject.quote: The GRE Biology Test and the GRE Literature in English Test were discontinued in May 2021.

deadline.value: Applications must be received by January 8 for fall entry and to be considered for funding.
deadline.quote: Applications for admission must be received by the Biological Sciences Department by Jan. 8 to be considered for both admission and funding for fall semester of the following academic year.

gre_general.value: The GRE is no longer needed for admission.
gre_general.quote: Note: The GRE is no longer needed for admission.

toefl_min.value: Biological Sciences requires a TOEFL iBT of 90.

supervisor.value: Applicants name three potential faculty advisers; listing one does not guarantee a place in that lab.
supervisor.quote: a list of three active graduate faculty members the student is interested in as advisers

also.quote: listing a faculty member as a potential advisor does not guarantee admission to that specific faculty member’s lab

funding.value: Admission and funding are ranked, and aid depends on availability for students who need it.
funding.quote: All admissions are based on a hierarchal ranking of students and, if the student requires financial aid, on the availability of funding.

entry_route.value: Students can enter with an M.S. or directly; M.S. entrants get five years of program support.
entry_route.quote: Ph.D. students entering the program with an M.S. degree can receive program-derived support for a maximum of five years after they enter the program

notes: The Biological Sciences PhD includes an Integrative Physiology and Neuroscience concentration, so neuro is in also_fields. A separate Molecular and Cellular Biology PhD is listed as a related program on the biology PhD page; its own admissions rules were not fetched.
